28 Aug 2023
A claim was opened for a side impact at an intersection, and the cliamant is reporting a shoulder injury. The claimant
is not represented by a lawyer.
1 Sep 2023
Spoke with the claimant, who described the collision the same way as in the first report, including the other vehicle
entering from the right. The claimant also confirmed being a passenger in the veihcle at the time.
7 Oct 2023
The police report and two independent witnesses support the account of how the collision happened. Scene photos
and the other driver's statement match it as well.
25 Oct 2023
The vehicle damage matches the described impact. The driver is named on the policy, and nothing indicates the
damage predates the start of coverage.
7 Nov 2023
Prior records show major damage to the same areas from an earlier accident that was never reported to us, and the
claimant is now presenting that damage as new. The claimant has not yet explained the difference.
22 Nov 2023
Medical records document a shoulder injury, but it is not yet clear whether this collision caused it. No earlier injury to
the same shoulder is known.
25 Nov 2023
Treatment has grown to many times the usual amount for this injury, with near-daily visits and new body areas added
several weeks after the collision. An independent medical review has been requested.
3 Feb 2024
Next steps are to obtain the complete prior claim history and the treating physician's notes, complete the independent
review, and hold any settlement decision until the results are in.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
